summary: The array always contains exactly three values and each representation has at most seven bits, so the complete legal workload is too tightly bounded for honest runtime scaling.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The public contract fixes nums.length at 3, yielding exactly 3! = 6 possible orders, and restricts every value to at most seven bits.

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted source visits all six positional permutations and performs exactly three constant-width shift-and-OR updates for each one.
Authored cases cover duplicate values, one- through seven-bit widths, non-numeric optimal orders, values near 127, and three maximum values.
